script_text: Stop! Libra, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars is forming a tense square to your ruling planet Venus, igniting friction in your 7th House of Partnerships and stirring tension in your relationships. At the same time, Jupiter trines your 10th House of Career, delivering a sudden surge in professional visibility and an opportunity for recognition. As an air sign, your mind is buzzing with fresh ideas that could spark a romantic connection. If you're single, a charismatic stranger may appear; if you're taken, watch for unresolved arguments surfacing. In the realm of money, the 2nd House of Income receives an unexpected bonus from a side venture, boosting your financial outlook. Avoid impulsive spending today, as Mercury retrograde in your 6th House can cause miscommunication and errors. Consider this a cosmic nudge to pause and reassess. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
